content.comment_body: Hello, I am not getting outputs from my counters when I use them in my logic. Additionally, I encounter an error when transferring the program from my PC to the [product_name] module. I am working with the up/down counter, but have tried using all counter types. Thanks,
Please upload your program as a zip archive.
My suggestion, based on prior experience, is to avoid using LAD view for this [product_name] device. The solution to your question can be seen in the attached image.
This solved my issue, thank you.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter difficulties when integrating counters into logic within the [product_name] platform, including missing outputs and errors during program transfer. Feedback highlights challenges with certain programming views, like LAD, and the solution involved altering the workflow. This points to opportunities for improved interface guidance or clearer instructions for configuring counters.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect all counters to provide visible outputs in logic view and program transfers to hardware modules to complete without errors.
